events.speaker: NELL
events.text: Supper's on, so sit down. It was on before you rode in. No, I wasn't expecting you in particular, only somebody. If the bell goes while we're eating, let it go. It has better manners than most who've stopped here.

events.speaker: NELL
events.text: You ate, you didn't watch the door, and when it rang you asked what was coming after. Nobody's managed that since the mine played out. Have the last of the peaches, I'll not eat them.

events.speaker: NELL
events.text: I'll ride with you. I'll want back through here now and again, though, and a night at the tower when the season turns. Somebody has to mind that rope and I've never found it a burden.

events.speaker: NELL
events.text: I talk back to a bell most nights and I've never much cared who heard me at it. You heard me. You didn't pull a face. I'd sooner you went on hearing it.
